name: linkedin
description: Post a copy of each new post to your LinkedIn profile, linked back to your site
author: Symbiosis Lab

settings.label: Access token
settings.description: Made with LinkedIn's token generator for your app, with the scopes openid, profile and w_member_social. It lasts 60 days.

settings.label: Articles
settings.description: Send long pages as LinkedIn articles, pasted into LinkedIn's own editor. Off, a long page is posted as its opening with a link.
